full_prompt_en: A square, densely worked drawing presents a young man from the chest upward against a dark wall of overlapping green leaves. The background fills every visible corner, so its foliage forms a continuous patterned surface rather than a distant landscape. Small leaves in muted olive, gray green, and pale yellow green sit over nearly black spaces; thin veins and irregular edges make the growth legible without separating every leaf from the mass. In the center, the young man turns his head slightly toward the right side of the image. His short cropped hair forms a dark, granular cap, while the left ear and the near side of his neck remain visible. His eyes look to the right with a calm, attentive expression, and the highlights in the eyes are small beside the broad dark areas around them. The face is built from closely packed strokes and changing densities of charcoal gray and deep brown, with a softer gray plane across the forehead and cheek. Darker passages gather beneath the brow, around the nose, below the lower lip, and along the underside of the jaw. The lips hold a restrained warm brown note within the otherwise cool, low light face. Across the lower part of the frame, a loose collared shirt shows narrow cream and gray stripes, a darker checked area near the left shoulder, and fine vertical lines in the shadowed right half. Foreground leaves cross the shirt at both lower corners, tying the figure to the patterned backdrop. Light falls gently from the upper left and catches selected leaf edges, the front of the forehead, and the shirt collar; the far side of the face and torso recede into deep shadow. Fine directional marks remain visible through the lit and shaded surfaces, giving the image a hand drawn, almost engraved density. The overall composition balances the dark central head against the restless green field, with quiet expression and restrained color held together by intricate line texture.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、笔触密集的绘画，一位年轻男子的胸部以上肖像置于深色且层叠的绿叶前。背景填满各个可见角落，叶丛形成连续的纹样表面，而不是遥远的风景。暗橄榄绿、灰绿和浅黄绿色的小叶覆盖在近乎黑色的空隙上；细叶脉和不规则边缘使枝叶可辨，却不把每片叶子从整体中割裂出来。画面中央，年轻男子的头略转向画面右侧。他剪得很短的头发像一层深色颗粒，左耳和靠近观者一侧的颈部仍可见。他的眼睛平静而专注地望向右方，眼中的小亮点与周围宽大的暗区形成对照。面部由紧密排列的笔痕和木炭灰、深褐色不同密度的区域构成，额头与面颊有较柔和的灰色平面。更深的色调聚在眉下、鼻周、下唇下方及下颌底部。嘴唇在整体偏冷、低照度的面部中保留克制的暖褐色。画面下方，一件宽松的翻领衬衫呈现奶油白与灰色细条纹，左肩附近有较深的格纹，右半部阴影里可见细竖线。前景叶片从下方两角伸到衬衫前，使人物与纹样背景相连。光柔和地从左上方落下，照亮若干叶缘、额头正面和衣领；面部及躯干较远的一侧退入深影。细密且有方向性的笔痕贯穿亮部与暗部，让图像具有近似版画的手绘密度。整体构图以深色的中央头像平衡繁密绿叶，细致线条把安静的神情与克制的色彩连在一起。
style_prompt_en: The image has a densely layered drawn surface with fine, directional marks that make tonal planes feel engraved rather than smoothly blended. Dark charcoal and deep brown occupy broad areas, while muted greens and small yellow green accents break through them in irregular clusters. Closely spaced strokes thicken around recesses and separate into lighter, more open passages at illuminated edges. Contours remain readable, yet interior planes are assembled from overlapping lines and granular marks instead of flat fills. A shallow, compressed space brings patterned background and focal form close together, with small overlaps at the edges binding the layers. Gentle light from one upper side picks out narrow highlights against substantial shadow, so texture carries much of the volume. The overall effect is intimate and intricate, with restrained color and dense marks held in a clear dark to light hierarchy.
style_prompt_zh: 图像表面由密集层叠的绘画痕迹构成，细小且有方向性的线条使明暗平面具有刻画感，而非平滑晕染。木炭灰与深褐色占据大面积，低饱和绿色和少量黄绿色亮点以不规则的簇状穿插其中。紧密笔痕在凹暗处加厚，在受光边缘分开为更轻、更疏的区域。轮廓仍可辨，内部平面却由重叠线条与颗粒状笔痕构成，而非平涂色块。浅而压缩的空间让带纹样的背景与焦点形体贴近，边缘的少量交叠把层次连在一起。来自一侧上方的柔光在大片阴影旁挑出狭窄亮部，肌理因此承担了大部分体积塑造。整体效果亲近而繁密，克制的色彩与密集笔痕服从清晰的深浅层级。
theme_en: A close portrait of a young man before dense green foliage
theme_zh: 浓密绿叶前一位年轻男子的近景肖像
name: Toyin Ojih Odutola
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
